name: crucible-works
line: a business platform built to prove cauldron
question: Could a zero-dependency framework carry a real multi-tenant product?
body: A multi-tenant business platform built on cauldron to prove it could carry a real product — CRM, CMS, knowledge base, billing, and two agent runtimes on schema-per-tenant Postgres — archived with it once the point was made.
alt: crucible-works — tenants standing on their own schema slices of one Postgres, on a cauldron foundation
